info.title: Răng Sáng API
info.description:
What the app's HTTP client (src/lib/api.ts) asks of a server, and what the mock (src/lib/mock.ts) answers. Each operationId is a method of Client. `pnpm check:contract` holds the client and the mock to this file; `pnpm stub` serves it from the mock. Every write (POST, PATCH, DELETE) carries X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest; a server using the session cookie refuses a write without it (cross-site request forgery).

Every operation says what it takes and does: x-permission (an action of src/lib/set-actions.ts, or signed-in / public), x-branch-scoped (true: a workspace or record outside the person's branches is a 403 not_member, "all" needs set.branch.all and covers only theirs; "hidden": a record outside them is answered 404, as one that isn't there; "filter": the answer holds only the person's branches' records; "clinical": as "filter" for anyone without emr.history.view, every branch's for those with it (the doctors, the owner), read only, each carrying its branch's code and no money (P3, ADR 0022); false: the clinic's, as a patient is, ADR 0021; nested objects of a branch, a visit linked from a tooth's event, follow the same rule), x-masks (each {path, unless, as}: the field at path is "masked" (asterisks), "absent", or "equals" value for a reader without the unless permission(s), "where" narrowing the rows and "fields" the changes it applies to; no unless is for everyone), x-audit (the lines of the log it writes: each at the acting branch, the X-Branch the call carries when it is one of the person's, or the branch of the record acted on when that is a branch's; never a patient's own branch). A server copies them: hiding a button is not the check (ADR 0019). Every call carries X-Branch: the workspace the person works in now (none for every branch), which the log's lines take (ADR 0022). An export needs the view of what it exports as well as its own permission, and writes every cell starting =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return with a ' before it.
